entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1869302503206674304: position at J2016.0. Distance: Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 197989: the Gaia DR2 (Gaia Collaboration 2018) parallax the radius was computed with (Table 1), 43.18 +/- 0.94 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431): 23.159 +/- 0.504 pc; Gaia DR3 gives this source no parallax (a two-parameter solution). Proper motion: Gaia DR3 source 1869302503206674304 is a two-parameter solution with no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 23 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 0 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1869302503206674304 (quality A), from 2018A&A...616A...7S; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 12.41 +/- 0.3 solar radii from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 197989: radius 12.41 +0.29/-0.3 solar radii (Table 5), from the limb-darkened angular diameter 4.985 +/- 0.046 mas (NPOI, Table 4) and the Gaia DR2 (Gaia Collaboration 2018) parallax (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac2431). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4659 +/- 35 K from Baines et al. (2021), AJ 162, 198, HD 197989: effective temperature 4659 +/- 35 K (Table 5), from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux of the SED fit.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Epsilon Cygni is HR 7949., cross-checked against Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 959: HR 7949; VizieR III/202 (4 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe3be. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 197989 is not in the library; kiehling: HR 7949 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,659 K and log g 2.67 (u1 0.731, u2 0.070): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
